methodology:
Almarai is the largest Saudi dairy company. The farmland exposure is partial — most of the SAR 25,093M Net PP&E reflects dairy plants, poultry processing, bakeries, and distribution. The pure-farmland subset is Fondomonte Argentina (~14K hectares producing fodder for export to Saudi feedlots) plus Saudi forage farms.

This comp is included for completeness but the FMV-vs-book displayed is essentially meaningless — Almarai's entire enterprise is mostly NOT a farmland operator. A stricter comp framework would either exclude Almarai entirely or carve out only Fondomonte's ~$50M of identifiable farmland book.

Values should be read as illustrative of partial-farmland exposure within a larger food enterprise rather than as direct farmland comparables.
